basis_probe.heavy_definition: first global product prime_support evaluation of a nontrivial radicand in the fresh p011 prepare+coverage process; on 75f this is exactly an uncached call to old exact _factorize. It is intentionally broader than the two target operation scopes: PREPARE has 52 misses and COVERAGE adds 16

timing_policy: wall-clock seconds are printed beside the receipt hash but are excluded from canonical bytes so independent runs must match
